dwargon_students_backstory.source: Arlequino direct recollection T+130 late night
facts: Arlequino gathered people at a Dwargon concert hall at 07:00 by announcing free lessons in guitar, violin and flute.
After they gathered, he made them choose only one instrument direction; the people split into groups.
He gave his three instruments to those groups and told each group to create music by the next morning.
Lessons had spectators; next morning Arlequino announced that only those chosen by spectators were worthy to be called musicians, but he ultimately kept everyone.
Next stage: three groups created music together, each with a soloist who had won the audience choice, again by the next morning.

Arlequino later wrote/adapted a play called 'Тод' for them in about twenty minutes according to his own uncertain recollection and asked them to stage it within one week; they did, with some distortions Arlequino considered acceptable.
Before that they also staged a play called 'Газель и Эмилия'; exact plot/roles remain UNKNOWN.
Arlequino wanted to take a couple of the students with him but did not insist.
Before leaving, Arlequino left each student either a guitar, violin or flute.
dwargon_students_backstory.precision_note: The 'about twenty minutes' detail is approximate because Arlequino explicitly said 'вроде'.
